messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Acme Halo opened an escalation, ticket CH-8421. After last night's reranker rollout (v3) they're seeing a big drop in grounding: results missing citations or pointing to wrong docs for clinical guideline queries. They pasted a few examples. Can someone triage?

nina_support: ack. Can you paste one reproducible query + response they saw? Also which endpoint (search vs rerank API) and model id?

maria_cs: endpoint: /v1/rerank; model: rdx-rerank-v3; sample query they sent: 

```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"query":"What are the first-line treatments for acute otitis media in adults?","candidates":[{"id":"doc:237","text":"CDC guideline: ...","source":"kb"},{"id":"doc:981","text":"forum post: ...","source":"web"}] ,"top_k":5 }'\n```

Response (customer): 

```{"query":"What are the first-line treatments for acute otitis media in adults?","ranked":[],"citations":[]}  # basically empty/irrelevant
```

They compared the same call against rdx-rerank-v2 and that returned the expected documents + citations.

ben_infra: Thanks — I'm looking at last night's deploy. Deploy-bot shows: deploy-bot: "deploy rdx-rerank-v3 @1999990123 by ben_infra -> canary -> prod". Any config changes included in that rollout?

maria_cs: release notes mentioned "embedding normalization and minor scoring tweak" but not flagged as breaking. Customer says nothing else changed on their side.

sam_ml: suspicion: embedding normalization toggle can change dot-product sims a lot if downstream reranker expects raw vector scale. If we normalized embeddings but didn't retrain or adjust reranker weights/thresholds, top-k recall can drop. Also check whether candidate generation (retrieval) or only reranker changed.

nina_support: I asked the customer for a narrow repro set (5 queries) and the original ranked list from v2. They sent 6 examples — uploading 1 here (redacted): query, expected top doc id doc:237 but v3 returns none.

ben_infra: quick audit of the release commits shows a one-line change in embedding pipeline: "normalize_embeddings=true" (commit 0c9e4f1). It was intended to stabilize cross-batch scoring but looks like we flipped it globally. That would explain the sudden shift.

sam_ml: that matches. We should run a quick micro-eval across seed queries (50) comparing MRR/recall between v2 and v3. But for customer impact mitigation, we can either: 1) rollback the embedding normalization for now, or 2) enable tenant-scoped flag to disable normalization for Acme while we fix models. Option 2 gives fastest mitigation with less churn.

maria_cs: customer is in a production launch tomorrow — they want an immediate fix. Nina, can we ask them to run the same curl after we flip whatever flag? Also they requested logs (rerank scores) for the failing calls.

ben_infra: I can flip a tenant override. Plan: set rerank.embedding_norming.enabled=false for tenant acme-halo-prod and invalidate the rerank cache for their tenant. Steps: 
1) update feature-flag in config service (internal endpoint) 
2) POST /internal/cache/invalidate?tenant=acme-halo-prod&scope=rerank 
3) watch metrics for traffic, run the 6 repro queries.

deploy-bot: Deploy record: "feature-flag update by ben_infra @1999991800"

sam_ml: after the flag is flipped, I'll run a scripted evaluation to compute recall@5 across the customer's repro set and a 50-query seed set. If we see recovery, we can keep the tenant override while we re-calibrate the reranker scoring (or retrain with normalized vectors).

nina_support: I told the customer we'll apply a config change and asked them to retry in 15m. Also requested their logs (original curl + response) — they uploaded them to the ticket.

ben_infra: Done — tenant override set and cache invalidated at 1999992005. Please retest and paste results.

maria_cs: Customer just confirmed initial tests show citations back for 5/6 repro queries. They're running a broader smoke test now. I'll keep CH-8421 updated.

sam_ml: I'll start a small re-run to quantify the delta and open a follow-up patch: either retrain the score head for normalized vectors or add a scaling factor to emulate pre-normalization magnitudes. Filing ENG-rr-449.

ben_infra: note to self: patch commit 0c9e4f1 should have been behind a rollout flag. Creating an action item to add a release checklist item for vector representation changes.

maria_cs: amazing, thanks all. I'll mark this as high priority on the support ticket and follow up with the customer after their full smoke test completes. :thumbsup:
